action_item_for_main_agent: INFRASTRUCTURE ISSUE: Cache-Control headers are being overridden by Cloudflare/ingress. Backend code correctly sets 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' (routes_profile.py:290) but responses show 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. This prevents browser/CDN caching. Investigate Cloudflare settings or ingress configuration to allow Cache-Control passthrough for /api/uploads/* endpoints.

additional_notes.performance_impact: Cache-Control issue means images are not cached at browser/CDN, negating performance benefits. Fix is infrastructure-level, not code-level.
additional_notes.code_quality: Backend implementation is correct and follows best practices. Frontend UserPhoto component correctly uses size prop to append ?w= parameter.
additional_notes.test_coverage: Backend: comprehensive. Frontend: limited by test data (no uploaded photos in test account). Code review confirms correct implementation.
